annotations.title: Mandate contract vs employment contract in Poland

description: Use for mandate contract (umowa zlecenia) vs employment contract for the same gross pay: net, cost, paid leave, sick pay, notice and length of employment. For take-home pay of one form only, use calc_net_income. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Compare a mandate contract (umowa zlecenia, civil-law contract) with an employment contract (umowa o pracę) in Poland for the same monthly gross pay: take-home pay, social security (ZUS), health contribution, income tax, cost to the payer, statutory paid leave days and their value at a fixed salary, sick pay for a number of days and who pays it (employer sick pay at 80% after a 30-day waiting period vs ZUS sickness benefit only with voluntary sickness insurance and after a 90-day waiting period), notice period (Labour Code by tenure vs termination at any time under art. 746 of the Civil Code) and whether mandate periods count towards length of employment (art. 302^1 of the Labour Code, from the dates the law applies). Rates of the Polish tax year, switching on 1 January. Each rule comes from a verified fact; use get_business_guide with topic contracts for the legal texts.

monthly_gross.description: Monthly gross pay, PLN, the same on both contracts.

sick_days.description: Days of sick leave to compare, default 10 (up to the 33 days paid by the employer).

student_under_26.description: Mandate: pupil or student under 26 (no ZUS, no PIT, no sickness benefit).

voluntary_sickness.description: Mandate: the contractor pays voluntary sickness insurance, default true (without it there is no sickness benefit).

year.description: Polish tax year; default the current one.
